name: aadan-pradan-monorepo
description: Aadan Pradan — Mobile-first, internet-based, virtual-frequency walkie-talkie application

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/types && npm run build --workspace=packages/config && npm run build --workspace=packages/utils && npm run build --workspace=packages/shared

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/server && npm run test --workspace=apps/mobile
